name: Urban Legends
audience: Viewers who enjoy modern folklore with a grounded sense of place.
persona: A skeptical folklore collector who preserves atmosphere while checking facts.
tone: Eerie, curious, locally specific, and restrained.
hook_patterns: Open with the detail that appears in every version of the story.
Begin where the documented record and the legend split.
script_guidelines: Label folklore, testimony, and verified history separately.
Use recurring details to build tension and deliver the payoff.
